Contextual translation pipeline

Astra processes each visible text block through a translation pipeline that preserves local formatting while attaching contextual metadata for better model disambiguation.

The content script collects stable blocks, batches them conservatively, and sends each batch through a background runtime bridge so provider secrets never leave extension storage.

Documentation pages often contain sidebars and utility chrome, so the extraction layer must prefer longform instructional content over navigation labels or page furniture.

When a user asks for an inline explanation, Astra should reuse page summary context to clarify terminology, pronouns, and the tone of the surrounding article.
